values: Data loss, security, unsafe side effect, or repo cannot be safely tested.
destructive side effect without approval; credential leak/mutation; remote execution without approval; email/release/tag/push without approval; installer mutates real HOME during isolated test
Must be highlighted in executive summary with reproduction command and affected feature IDs.
Stop unsafe phase; isolate evidence; fix before broader execution.
Core capability or safety contract broken.
core workflow broken; evidence gate accepts malformed artifact; fixture counted as live/full parity; install/doctor fails; TaskGraph hidden black-box runner; gate policy bypass
Summarize under major blockers; include exact tests and artifacts.
Important feature partial/failing, but workaround or safe blocked state exists.
workflow produces incomplete evidence; UI/runtime feature degraded; provider-specific path unavailable; partial implementation has honest limitation
Include in detailed failures and missing-test plan.
Schedule fix or mark as bounded limitation.
documentation mismatch; missing convenience command; non-core visual defect; indirect test only
naming inconsistency; stale comment; duplicate fixture; low-risk maintenance
